searchText: This is our postmortem for the OpenEthereum v3.2.0 consensus error after the Berlin Upgrade: https://docs.google.com/document/d/18BhIEB7V_f_GkL8NZptxq-xadu5sb8QUzego8YVVMUM/edit#heading=h.nxtmf7qzhoyo We want to send a small gift to everybody who helped us during the consensus error incident. I made a list of people. Please let me know if I'm missing someone: holiman #3749, sorpaas #5636, Artem, Micah, Rai, eb from geth, MariusVanDerWijden #9107, YorickDowne (he/him) #0990, tkstanczak #3105, Jochem #8569, Tim Beiko, OpenEthereum Developers+Denis+ Ronin. Please send me an Ethereum address to my DM 🙂 **Out of band call: AllCoreDevs in ~21.5 hours (Apr 23, 14:00 UTC)** Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/301 Stream: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C9hzAYkklQM Note, I reached out to the various client teams this week to get their thoughts on London timing and the various proposed EIPs. I've aggregated their responses and shared the summary as a comment on the agenda. We can obviously discuss the various points tomorrow, but hopefully this can help speed things up in cases where there are no objections 👍 Is there a way to join the team working on the whisper protocol ? <@!295888087349723146> Whisper has a long history, I think the Status team has a lot of background in this, you could ask in the Nimbus discord: https://discord.gg/hArRayrXvS re the fuzzer missing openEthereum testnet, is there an OE equivalent to Geth's --OverrideBerlin=height which could be set lower for fuzzing on mainnet specs? IIRC Whisper is long dead and Status are developing a replacement called Waku This was my understanding as well You can also search for Vacp2p, they are the team working on waking currently
